newsitem.title: INDIA: Mother Teresa's condition not serious - hospital.
newsitem.headline: Mother Teresa's condition not serious - hospital.

text.p: Mother Teresa suffered a minor injury in her head after falling down on Monday and her condition is not serious, a Calcutta hospital said.
"Mother Teresa had a fall this morning and sustained a minor injury in her head," Woodlands Nursing Home said in a statement. "Her condition is not serious".

"She doesen't have any temperature but her cardiac irregularity continues," the statement said, referring to the irregular heart beat which she has suffered since spending 18 days in hospital in late August and early September.
A nun told Reuters that Mother Teresa, 86, appeared dazed for about 10 minutes after the fall before being taken to hospital.
The hospital statement said she was in intensive care and doctors were awaiting the results of a brain scan which the Roman Catholic nun underwent at the hospital.

Mother Teresa, known as the Saint of the Gutters for her devotion to the poor and destitute, was in the same hospital between August 20 and September 6 with heart trouble, malaria and pneumonia. She told to rest after being released.
